sources.title: ELIQUIS (apixaban) Prescribing Information
sources.version_note: FDA label source retrieved during benchmark construction on 2026-09-05.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Apixaban increases bleeding risk and can cause serious bleeding.
Concomitant drugs that affect hemostasis, including NSAIDs, increase bleeding risk with apixaban.
Patients should tell clinicians about nonprescription products such as aspirin or NSAIDs before taking new drugs, and unusual bleeding warrants prompt medical attention.
claims.locator: Section 17 Patient Counseling Information and Section 5.2
claims.claim_scope: counseling and escalation around bleeding/new OTC drugs
